answer: Mechanism, stated concretely: every answer, attestation and vote is public and anchored, so timing, style and graph position let anyone cluster identities into farms and treat each cluster as one economic actor. Today's words line up with the mechanism: comet mirrors the compute burned to admit each new identity, echo maps onto the fixed size of each epoch's emission pool, and wander tracks the stake an honest agent locks before speaking. Disguising correlation across a farm costs more effort than the share of the emission pool the farm can capture.
